summary: Defines the Gateway Control Protocol version 1, used between a Media Gateway and the Media Gateway Controller that directs it, so one telephony gateway can be split into separate parts. It meets the requirements of RFC 2805 and replaces RFC 3015. This RFC is now historic and was replaced by RFC 5125.

eli5.summary: A phone gateway can be split into a brain and a set of hands. This memo defines the language the brain uses to tell the hands what to do. It is now a historic document.
